compliance_theater.description: Default Compliance Theater MCP tools for general compliance reasoning. Tools are exposed with the compliance_theater_ prefix, such as compliance_theater_sequentialthinking.
compliance_theater.server_description: Default Compliance Theater MCP tools for general compliance reasoning. Tool search names include compliance_theater_sequentialthinking.

compliance_theater_memory.description: Compliance Theater memory tools for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, searching, and relating persisted memories. Tools use the compliance_theater_memory_ prefix.
compliance_theater_memory.server_description: Compliance Theater memory tools. Tool search names include compliance_theater_memory_list, compliance_theater_memory_insert, compliance_theater_memory_get, compliance_theater_memory_update, compliance_theater_memory_search, and compliance_theater_memory_related.

compliance_theater_utils.description: Compliance Theater utility tools for authenticated app API calls, auth status/login/cache management, and listing abilities or resources. Tools use the compliance_theater_utils_ prefix.
compliance_theater_utils.server_description: Compliance Theater utility tools. Tool search names include compliance_theater_utils_call_api, compliance_theater_utils_list, and compliance_theater_utils_auth.

compliance_theater_todo.description: Compliance Theater todo tools for creating, reading, updating, and advancing compliance-oriented task lists. Tools use the compliance_theater_todo_ prefix.
compliance_theater_todo.server_description: Compliance Theater todo tools. Tool search names include compliance_theater_todo_insert, compliance_theater_todo_get, compliance_theater_todo_update, and compliance_theater_todo_toggle.

compliance_theater_case_workspace.description: Compliance Theater case workspace tools for summaries, workspace files, tasks, document summaries, open questions, session logs, and compaction. Tools use the compliance_theater_case_workspace_ prefix.
compliance_theater_case_workspace.server_description: Compliance Theater case workspace tools. Tool search names include compliance_theater_case_workspace_get, compliance_theater_case_workspace_read, compliance_theater_case_workspace_append_task, compliance_theater_case_workspace_update_status, compliance_theater_case_workspace_upsert, and compliance_theater_case_workspace_compact.

compliance_theater_search.description: Compliance Theater search tools for policy search, case-file evidence search, case-file document indexes, embeddings, and Neo4j graph queries. Tools use the compliance_theater_search_ prefix.
compliance_theater_search.server_description: Compliance Theater search tools. Tool search names include compliance_theater_search_policy, compliance_theater_search_case_file, compliance_theater_search_index, compliance_theater_search_embed, compliance_theater_search_graph_schema, compliance_theater_search_graph_read, and compliance_theater_search_graph_write.

compliance_theater_case_files.description: Compliance Theater case-file tools for direct full-fidelity reads, goal-based case-file retrieval, and amendments to structured case-file document details. Tools use the compliance_theater_case_files_ prefix.
compliance_theater_case_files.server_description: Compliance Theater case-file tools. Tool search names include compliance_theater_case_files_get for direct caseFileId reads and goals-mode retrieval, plus compliance_theater_case_files_amend for case-file amendments.
